question: Can a rigorous, rate-specific omitted-tail bound restrict the uncomputed private-error contribution after each of the four existing complete first records?
frozen_model: R6AF ideal periodic L=2 D4 36-IID-red-X-edge physical channel, p_X=1/10 and p_Z=0 inherited from J7S; full-binary public first flux/charge/vacuum with vacuum=1-charge before two fixed relation-free public actions. Only J8J's selected first-flux sector and the four corrected J8K first records are evaluated. Generation/scoring and private error supports remain inaccessible to actions.

hypotheses.tight: Known-law joint first-record weight dominates a rigorous upper bound on unknown posterior weight for each tested record.
hypotheses.loose: An omitted private-error tail can still dominate at one or more tested first records, leaving the full-prior mixture unresolved.

matrix.independent_unit: One exact private red-X support and one complete first public record; no random sample or uncertainty interval.
matrix.estimator: For each record o, A=sum_known P(e)P(o|e), T=P(selected first flux)-sum_known P(e). Since every omitted P(o|e)<=1, omitted posterior weight <=T/(A+T), and P(o) is in [A,A+T].
matrix.known_law_sets: All-plus uses the 67-support union of corrected J8K and J8I; each other record uses 13 corrected J8K supports, including zero-mass exclusions. Check both fixed action-conditioned second laws equal the respective base within each known positive subset.
matrix.integrity: Exact Fraction arithmetic, public vacuum=1-charge and complete 24-bit record, common selected flux and actions, unique support union 67, corrected first-mass agreement on overlap, exact J8J known-prior-weight replay, no input hash drift, no Born evaluation or new second laws. Fail closed on any mismatch.

acceptance: Four exact rational joint-mass and omitted-posterior upper-bound rows, with corrected public records and pinned inputs
Both actions have equal complete second laws inside each known positive first-record subset
No extrapolation to omitted first laws, other flux sectors, full-IID information, logical risk, noisy JIT or threshold
stop_rule: Stop after four records or first integrity/CPU/cell cap. A loose bound is a valid censored result; do not choose a favorable record or expand the rate/flux/size grid post hoc.
